name: sessionmap
author: Hao
description: A persistent external thinking tree for parallel AI coding sessions

scripts.check:app: swiftc -parse-as-library -typecheck -framework AppKit -framework WebKit desktop/macos/SessionMapApp.swift && plutil -lint desktop/macos/Info.plist >/dev/null
scripts.check:release: sh -n scripts/install.sh scripts/macos/postinstall && plutil -lint scripts/macos/entitlements.plist desktop/macos/Info.plist >/dev/null && xmllint --noout scripts/macos/Distribution.xml
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run check:web && bun run check:privacy && bun run check:app && bun run check:release && bun test && bun run build && bun run build:app
